name: ESO 222-010 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 222-010, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso22210-hubble
story: A dwarf irregular galaxy on the outskirts of the Centaurus A group, it lies close to the plane of our own Milky Way, where foreground dust dims the view. Hubble visited it in an effort to resolve the brightest stars of every known nearby galaxy.

claims.text: ESO 222-010 (ESO 222-G010, HIPASS J1434-49) is a dwarf irregular galaxy at low Galactic latitude
It lies in the outskirts of the Centaurus A group
Foreground extinction toward it is large; PGC 52125; type dIrr
Hubble observed it in a program to image every known nearby galaxy, resolving the brightest stars to measure distances
